headline: Fresh Fronts Erupt as Strategic Strongpoints Change Hands
war_summary: Since the previous dispatch, Fisherman's Row has come alive with nine strategic-base events in the latest two-hour watch, the busiest such interval among all theaters, and thirty-five over the day. Weathered Expanse remains fiercely active, logging six more events in the final two-hour reading and seventeen in the last six hours, with Frostmarch and Crow's Nest figuring prominently. Stlican Shelf, quiet at the last filing, has returned to action with four events in the latest window and thirty-one for the day; that region now stands divided, with one strongpoint still neutral. Tempest Island shows a fresh exchange at Reef at the cutoff itself, adding four events over the same two-hour period. Godcrofts, although without a new event in the past two hours, still carries the largest twenty-four-hour total in the data at sixty-two changes. Linn Mercy recorded ten events over the day and saw renewed fighting within the last six hours. The war remains undecided, as casualties climb on both sides.
